_readme: Fill in the coupled6_value fields from your vehicle's actual coupled6 config (diagonal terms only -- Unity's FossenDynamics has no off-diagonal added-mass/damping coupling). unity_field is the exact public field name on the FossenDynamics component to set. For damping, sum coupled6's potential-radiation + viscous contributions into a single best-fit linear/quadratic pair per axis -- see VALIDATION_HARNESS_SPEC.md section 2.2.

surge_Xudot.notes: matched-terms diagonal of the production symmetrized 6x6 added-mass matrix
surge_Xudot.source: artifacts/capytaine/vehicle-b-parametric-resolved.json runtime_parameters.addedMass.matrix6[0][0]; installed and symmetrized by backends/node/src/vehicle-b-production.ts buildVehicleBProductionConfiguration()

sway_Yvdot.notes: matched-terms diagonal of the production symmetrized 6x6 added-mass matrix
sway_Yvdot.source: artifacts/capytaine/vehicle-b-parametric-resolved.json runtime_parameters.addedMass.matrix6[1][1]; installed and symmetrized by backends/node/src/vehicle-b-production.ts buildVehicleBProductionConfiguration()

heave_Zwdot.notes: out-of-plane matched-terms diagonal; off-diagonal coupling remains excluded
heave_Zwdot.source: artifacts/capytaine/vehicle-b-parametric-resolved.json runtime_parameters.addedMass.matrix6[2][2]; installed and symmetrized by backends/node/src/vehicle-b-production.ts buildVehicleBProductionConfiguration()

roll_Kpdot.notes: out-of-plane matched-terms diagonal; off-diagonal coupling remains excluded
roll_Kpdot.source: artifacts/capytaine/vehicle-b-parametric-resolved.json runtime_parameters.addedMass.matrix6[3][3]; installed and symmetrized by backends/node/src/vehicle-b-production.ts buildVehicleBProductionConfiguration()

pitch_Mqdot.notes: out-of-plane matched-terms diagonal; off-diagonal coupling remains excluded
pitch_Mqdot.source: artifacts/capytaine/vehicle-b-parametric-resolved.json runtime_parameters.addedMass.matrix6[4][4]; installed and symmetrized by backends/node/src/vehicle-b-production.ts buildVehicleBProductionConfiguration()

yaw_Nrdot.notes: matched-terms diagonal of the production symmetrized 6x6 added-mass matrix
yaw_Nrdot.source: artifacts/capytaine/vehicle-b-parametric-resolved.json runtime_parameters.addedMass.matrix6[5][5]; installed and symmetrized by backends/node/src/vehicle-b-production.ts buildVehicleBProductionConfiguration()

surge_Xu.notes: matched diagonal = potential-radiation[0][0] 3.8950750079678884 + linear-viscous[0][0] 80 at the resolved 1.5707963267948966 rad/s frequency; production CoupledSixPlant suppresses this generic planar term because MMG replaces indices 0,1,5

sway_Yv.notes: matched diagonal = potential-radiation[1][1] 10.188997092682468 + linear-viscous[1][1] 210 at the resolved frequency; production suppresses this generic planar term in favor of MMG

roll_Kp.notes: out-of-plane matched diagonal = potential-radiation[3][3] 0.632705076483929 + linear-viscous[3][3] 1.1099326722941965; the viscous term is the tracked zero-speed Ikeda lower bound

yaw_Nr.notes: matched diagonal = potential-radiation[5][5] 0.24947393700035958 + linear-viscous[5][5] 520 at the resolved frequency; production suppresses this generic planar term in favor of MMG

surge_Xuu.notes: diagonal quadratic-viscous approximation; production suppresses this generic planar term in favor of MMG

sway_Yvv.notes: diagonal quadratic-viscous approximation; production suppresses this generic planar term in favor of MMG

roll_Kpp.notes: out-of-plane diagonal quadratic-viscous term from the tracked zero-speed Ikeda eddy lower bound

yaw_Nrr.notes: diagonal quadratic-viscous approximation; production suppresses this generic planar term in favor of MMG

mass_kg.source: artifacts/capytaine/vehicle-b-parametric-resolved.json runtime_parameters.massProps.mass; spread into VehicleParameters by backends/node/src/vehicle-b-production.ts buildVehicleBProductionConfiguration()

inertia_Ixx.notes: SNAME Ix is roll about body-forward x; body-forward maps to Unity local +z

inertia_Iyy.notes: SNAME Iy is pitch about body-starboard y; body-starboard maps to Unity local +x

inertia_Izz.notes: SNAME Iz is yaw about body-down z; the same physical axis is Unity local y (opposite direction does not change scalar diagonal inertia)

cg_offset.notes: For a nonzero SNAME [x_forward,y_starboard,z_down] vector, enter Unity local [y_starboard,-z_down,x_forward]
cg_offset.source: packages/vehicle-sdk/config/vehicle-b-usv-bootstrap.json x_g_m = 0; backends/node/src/vehicle-b-production.ts sets massProps.cg to {x: configuration.x_g_m, y: 0, z: 0}

propeller_diameter_m.source: packages/vehicle-sdk/config/vehicle-b-usv-bootstrap.json propeller.diameter_m; mapped to DP by packages/core/src/vehicle-b-mmg.js createVehicleBMmgParameters()

water_density_kg_m3.source: packages/core/src/vehicle-b-mmg.js createVehicleBMmgParameters() default rho; production restoring density also set in backends/node/src/vehicle-b-production.ts

nominal_wake_fraction.notes: Unity uses the nominal straight-line wake fraction; production MMG modifies wP with sideslip and yaw rate
nominal_wake_fraction.source: packages/vehicle-sdk/config/vehicle-b-usv-bootstrap.json propeller.w_P0; dynamic wake calculation in packages/core/src/mmg.js MmgManeuveringModel.computeComponents()

thrust_deduction_fraction.source: packages/vehicle-sdk/config/vehicle-b-usv-bootstrap.json interaction.t_P; applied as (1-t_P)*thrust in packages/core/src/mmg.js MmgManeuveringModel.computeComponents()

lag_time_constant_s.notes: Vehicle B first-order propeller RPS lag
lag_time_constant_s.source: packages/vehicle-sdk/config/vehicle-b-usv-bootstrap.json propeller.time_constant_s; exact exponential response applied by packages/core/src/vehicle-b-mmg.js VehicleBMmgForceModel.prepareStep()

water_density_kg_m3.source: backends/node/src/vehicle-b-production.ts buildVehicleBProductionConfiguration(): restoring.waterDensity = 1025; also default rho in packages/core/src/vehicle-b-mmg.js createVehicleBMmgParameters()

excluded_terms._note: coupled6 terms with no Unity FossenDynamics equivalent -- report separately as 'full coupled6' vs 'matched-terms' gap, not tuned away.
